stories.title: Consent Schema and Contract Validation Fixes
stories.description: Audit and correct Pydantic models in consent_models.py to enforce strict Tier 1 vs Tier 2 separation, required fields, consent timestamps, and de-identification flags. Ensure backward compatibility with existing stored records.

stories.title: Core Consent Logic Edge Case Fixes
stories.description: Fix defects in consent_service.py including improper tier escalation, duplicate consent submissions, partial consent persistence, and failures in summarization and HIPAA Safe Harbor de-identification paths.

stories.title: Consent API and Tool Routing Corrections
stories.description: Ensure consent enforcement is correctly triggered through tool_router.py and FastAPI endpoints, including gating before lead capture and unknown question handling, and preventing bypass of Tier 2 requirements.

stories.title: Consent Workflow Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Expand test coverage for consent flows including Tier 1 only, Tier 2 escalation, refusal handling, duplicate submissions, and de-identification validation across services.

stories.title: Lead Capture and Unknown Question Integration Fixes
stories.description: Fix integration inconsistencies between ConsentService, LeadService, and UnknownQuestionService to ensure consent state is consistently enforced across all entry points and no PHI is persisted without proper Tier 2 consent.
